ccimprove:clean-permissions.command_description: Clean up the permissions allow list in settings.json by removing one-off pastes, redundant entries, and dead MCP references

ccimprove:make-repeatable.command_description: Analyze recent work and propose how to make it repeatable as a skill or plugin

ccimprove:surface-usage-patterns.command_description: Surface usage patterns across all Claude Code sessions to identify opportunities for skills, plugins, agents, and CLAUDE.md improvements

company-setup:check-name.command_description: Check whether a candidate company name is available across USPTO, WA Secretary of State, and major domain TLDs. Outputs a single aggregated report.

dev:apply-feedback.command_description: Review [MK] comments in the current document and apply changes immediately without asking for permission

dev:code-review-iterative.argument_hint: Optional scope (file paths, branch name, or "staged")
dev:code-review-iterative.command_description: Run iterative code review with 3 parallel reviewers (PE, Sr SDE, QA) and diminishing fix thresholds across up to 4 iterations.

dev:design-review-iterative.argument_hint: Optional path to design doc (defaults to most recent in docs/)
dev:design-review-iterative.command_description: Run iterative design document review with 3 parallel reviewers (PE, Sr SDE, Domain Expert) and diminishing fix thresholds across up to 4 iterations.

dev:finish-work-on-local-worktree.command_description: Merge a local worktree into main, update doc statuses, update project plan, and recommend next work

dev:ml-design-review-iterative.argument_hint: Optional path to design doc (defaults to most recent in docs/)
dev:ml-design-review-iterative.command_description: Run iterative ML design review with 3 parallel reviewers (Principal ML Engineer, Sr Applied Scientist, ML Ops Engineer) and diminishing fix thresholds across up to 4 iterations.

dev:next-idea.command_description: "Propose the single smartest, most innovative, accretive addition to the current project (BLUF + Pyramid output)"

dev:review-feedback.command_description: Review [MK] comments in the current document, present a plan for changes, and apply after approval

dev:setup-doc-conventions.command_description: Bootstrap doc-conventions in the current project. Creates docs/templates/ (including dashboard.base), docs/dashboard.md, configures Obsidian, and appends workflow section to CLAUDE.md.

dev:summarize-this-session.command_description: "Summarize the current conversation: task progress and continuous improvement insights"

fetch:alphaxiv-paper.command_description: Look up an arxiv paper on alphaxiv.org for a structured AI-generated overview

fetch:blog-post.command_description: Download a blog post/article as a self-contained folder (clean markdown + images + digitized charts)

fetch:notion-public-site.command_description: Download all pages from a public Notion site as Markdown files with cross-references

fetch:scribd-document.command_description: Download all pages from a Scribd document as images

fetch:vedic-chart.command_description: Convert a Vedic horoscope chart image into structured JSON + ASCII North/South Indian charts

fetch:x-post.command_description: Extract content from an X/Twitter post, thread, or article using the gstack browser. Detects threads automatically and downloads images locally.

fetch:youtube-transcript.command_description: Extract transcript and metadata from a YouTube video using a persistent Chrome session

notes:clip.command_description: Clip any URL into the notes vault. Routes to the right extractor and note-writer based on the source type.

notes:create.command_description: Write a note into the current Obsidian vault, with frontmatter and folder placement.

think:adhd.command_description: Parallel divergent ideation. Spawns N isolated reasoning branches under different cognitive frames (regulator, biology, speedrunner, 10-year-old, $0 budget), scores them, prunes traps, and deepens the top survivors. For open-ended, high-stakes problems — architecture, naming, API surface design, fuzzy debugging, strategy. ~10 LLM calls per run, so reserve it for decision points.
